opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early gateway and gas, followed by Cybernetics Core for tech, with a focus on economy over early aggression.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high investment in technology (0.816) and economy (0.462), with low expansion (0.008) and no air or defense investment.
The first combat unit is observed in 100% of games, compared to a baseline of 30.2%, indicating early unit production.
The key sequence shows a gateway before gas, then a second gas, and a Cybernetics Core before the first combat unit, suggesting a tech-focused build.
